description: This file is a Perl module implementing the Git::SVN package, which provides integration between Git and SVN repositories. It includes functions for interacting with external SVN repositories, managing revisions, parsing metadata, and facilitating operations like fetching, commit, and reconstructing repository state within a Git context.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: Main package providing SVN-Git integration features, including revision management, remote repository interaction, metadata parsing, and repository state reconstruction.

methods.name: resolve_local_globs
methods.description: Resolves globs related to SVN refs to Git fetch paths, ensuring conflicts are handled.

methods.name: parse_revision_argument
methods.description: Parses revision arguments such as 'BASE:HEAD', numeric revisions, or special tokens.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all revisions from specified remotes, handling revision range calculation and glob expansion.

methods.name: read_all_remotes
methods.description: Reads and parses all configured remotes from git config.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes internal variables related to garbage collection.

methods.name: verify_remotes_sanity
methods.description: Verifies repository remotes are configured without ambiguity or conflicts.

methods.name: find_existing_remote
methods.description: Finds an existing remote URL in the configuration to avoid duplicate remote setup.

methods.name: init_remote_config
methods.description: Initializes or reuses remote configuration in the git config based on URL and existing remotes.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Locates a repository configuration based on a full URL, supporting optional repository root and path filters.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN object, optionally initializing remote configuration based on URL.

methods.name: refname
methods.description: Returns a sanitized reference name for the SVN reference identifier.

methods.name: desanitize_refname
methods.description: Converts a sanitized reference name back to its original form.

methods.name: svm_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of a stored SVN-VM link, with caching.

methods.name: svm
methods.description: Gets the SVM configuration section for the repository.

methods.name: ra_uuid
methods.description: Memoized method to retrieve or cache the SVN repository UUID.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Returns and caches the root URL of the SVN repository.

methods.name: ra
methods.description: Creates an SVN repository access object and initializes SVM properties if enabled.

methods.name: prop_walk
methods.description: Recursively walks SVN properties in a directory at a specific revision, invoking a callback for properties of interest.

methods.name: last_rev
methods.description: Returns the latest revision number committed in the repository.

methods.name: last_commit
methods.description: Returns the commit SHA of the latest revision.

methods.name: last_rev_commit
methods.description: Returns both the latest revision number and commit SHA, with caching.

methods.name: get_fetch_range
methods.description: Calculates the range of revisions to fetch from SVN.

methods.name: svn_dir
methods.description: Returns the SVN directory path within a git repository.

methods.name: tmp_config
methods.description: Executes a configuration command with a temporary config file setup.

methods.name: tmp_index_do
methods.description: Performs operations with a temporary GIT index environment.

methods.name: assert_index_clean
methods.description: Ensures the Git index matches a particular state, reindexing if necessary.

methods.name: get_commit_parents
methods.description: Determines the parent commits for a particular revision, including injected parents.

methods.name: rewrite_root
methods.description: Returns the configured rewrite root URL for the repository.

methods.name: rewrite_uuid
methods.description: Returns the configured rewrite UUID for the repository.

methods.name: metadata_url
methods.description: Constructs URL pointing to repository metadata.

methods.name: full_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete repository URL.

methods.name: full_pushurl
methods.description: Constructs the full push URL, if configured.

methods.name: set_commit_header_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for commit author, email, and date.

methods.name: restore_commit_header_env
methods.description: Restores previous commit header environment variables.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Runs garbage collection for Git repositories.

methods.name: do_git_commit
methods.description: Performs a commit in Git with proper metadata and parent calculation.

methods.name: match_paths
methods.description: Checks if repository path matches a set of rules for operations.

methods.name: find_parent_branch
methods.description: Locates the parent branch of a given branch by SVN path history.

methods.name: do_fetch
methods.description: Fetches revision data and updates repository state accordingly.

methods.name: mkemptydirs
methods.description: Creates empty directories as needed based on SVN logs and filesystem state.

methods.name: get_untracked
methods.description: Lists untracked or changed files and properties for SVN working state.

methods.name: parse_svn_date
methods.description: Parses SVN date strings into Git-compatible format with timezone information.

methods.name: other_gs
methods.description: Finds or creates a Git::SVN object for a different repository URL.

methods.name: call_authors_prog
methods.description: Invokes an external program to resolve author names and emails.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Verifies and sanitizes author strings.

methods.name: find_extra_svk_parents
methods.description: Finds additional parent commits from svk:merge properties.

methods.name: lookup_svn_merge
methods.description: Resolves SVN mergeinfo to corresponding Git commits.

methods.name: _rev_list
methods.description: Collects revision lists for a set of revisions, used in cherry-pick analysis.

methods.name: check_cherry_pick2
methods.description: Analyzes commits to determine which have no changes or are duplicates.

methods.name: has_no_changes
methods.description: Checks if a given commit has no code changes.

methods.name: tie_for_persistent_memoization
methods.description: Initializes persistent memoization storages for optimization.

methods.name: unmemoize_svn_mergeinfo_functions
methods.description: Clears cached mergeinfo analysis functions.

methods.name: clear_memoized_mergeinfo_caches
methods.description: Deletes persistent cache files associated with mergeinfo.

methods.name: parents_exclude
methods.description: Determines which parent commits to exclude based on merge ancestry.

methods.name: mergeinfo_changes
methods.description: Computes differences in svn:mergeinfo between revisions.

methods.name: find_extra_svn_parents
methods.description: Finds extra parent commits based on mergeinfo properties.

methods.name: make_log_entry
methods.description: Constructs and writes a detailed log entry for a revision including metadata, merge info, and properties.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches revisions from SVN and corresponding remote updates.

methods.name: set_tree_cb
methods.description: Sets the commit tree in preparation for a commit.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Creates a new commit tree with specified structure.

methods.name: rebuild_from_rev_db
methods.description: Reconstructs revision-to-commit mappings from old database files.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the internal rev_map from scratch, based on svn history.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Adds or updates a revision-to-commit mapping in the internal database.

methods.name: mkfile
methods.description: Creates a file at the specified path if it does not exist, ensuring parent directories are created.

methods.name: use_fsync
methods.description: Determines whether to use fsync based on environment variables and configuration, cached after first call.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Sets the mapping between SVN revision numbers and Git commits in the internal revision map database, optionally updating refs and managing lock files.

methods.name: rev_map_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum revision number and optionally the associated commit, rebuilding the revision map if needed.

methods.name: rev_map_max_norebuild
methods.description: Reads the revision map database to determine the maximum revision and associated commit without rebuilding.

methods.name: rev_map_get
methods.description: Retrieves the Git commit associated with a specific SVN revision from the revision map database.

methods.name: _rev_map_get
methods.description: Internal method to perform binary search within revision map database to find commit for a given revision.

methods.name: find_rev_before
methods.description: Finds the first SVN revision that exists before or on a given revision, within optional bounds, returning the associated commit.

methods.name: find_rev_after
methods.description: Finds the first SVN revision that exists after or on a given revision, within optional bounds, returning the associated commit.

methods.name: _new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN object, setting repository and reference IDs, and ensuring the directory structure exists.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Accessor and mutator for the SVN directory path within the repository.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Accessor and mutator for the canonicalized URL of the SVN repository.

methods.name: unlink_rev_db_symlink
methods.description: Removes the symbolic link for the revision database, if it exists.

methods.name: rev_db_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path for the revision database for a given UUID.

methods.name: map_path
methods.description: Determines the file path for storing revision mapping data based on UUID.

methods.name: uri_encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into a URI-safe format.

methods.name: uri_decode
methods.description: Decodes a URI-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: remove_username
methods.description: Removes user information from a URL if present.
